svg.title: Sound Creations Ltd Company Profile 2026 - Page 14

text.tspan: Each of Playza’s spaces needed a different kind of sound: discreet background
music in the offices and dining areas, and powerful, immersive sound in the bowling
and bar lounge, all integrated into the venue’s interior. We designed and installed a
multi-zone system, selecting the right loudspeaker for every area, with flexible
control throughout. From the dining room to the lanes, the venue now enjoys clarity,
consistency and an immersive entertainment experience.
Biamp CMX20DT ceiling speakers (rooms, offices, dining)
NEXO ID24 loudspeakers (bowling and bar lounge)
